Download the Priceline Pharmacy app

The free Priceline Pharmacy app lets you send eScripts ahead to Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in Broadbeach, get reminders when repeats are due, and manage your Sister Club rewards. Download it for iPhone or Android and choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair as your store, and your scripts will be ready when you arrive. Ask at the prescription counter if you’d like help setting it up.

Get the app Get it on Android

At a glance

What it is
The Priceline Pharmacy app for ordering prescriptions ahead, eScript reminders and rewards.
Who it's for
Anyone with an iPhone or Android phone.
Cost
Free.
Booking
Not needed.
How to book
Download the app and choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair as your store.

What can I do with the app?

  • order your prescription medicines ahead from Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair, so they’re ready when you arrive
  • add eScripts by pasting the token link or scanning the QR code
  • get reminders when it’s time to take a medicine or order a repeat
  • keep track of your scripts
  • access your Sister Club account and rewards

Where do I download it?

The app is free. Download for iPhone from the App Store, or download for Android from Google Play.

How do I set Pacific Fair as my pharmacy?

When you set up the app, choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair (Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Broadbeach) as your preferred store so your orders come to us.

Is there another way to send my script ahead?

Yes. You can also send your eScript to us through MedAdvisor, in the MedAdvisor app or in your browser. Either way, we’ll let you know when your prescription is ready to collect. See prescriptions and eScripts for all the ways to fill a script with us.

Need help getting set up?

Ask at the prescription counter at the back of the store and we’ll help you get set up, or call us on (07) 5592 2099.

Common questions

Is the Priceline Pharmacy app free?

Yes. The app is free to download for iPhone and Android. Get it from the App Store or Google Play.

How do I send a script with the app?

Add your eScript by pasting the token link or scanning the QR code, choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair as your store, and submit the order. We’ll let you know when it’s ready to collect.

Can I send a script without the app?

Yes. You can send your eScript to us through MedAdvisor in your browser, or simply show us the QR code at the prescription counter.

Does the app remind me when a repeat is due?

Yes. Turn on reminders and the app will prompt you when it’s time to take a medicine or order a repeat, and keep track of your scripts in one place.

Can I use my Sister Club rewards in the app?

Yes. The app gives you access to your Sister Club account and rewards. Ask our team if you’d like help joining.

How do I make Pacific Fair my pharmacy in the app?

When you set up the app, choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair (Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Broadbeach) as your preferred store so your orders come to us.

Can you help me set up the app?

Yes. Ask at the prescription counter and we’ll help you get set up.
